domain: Full latent probability tables, all complex Fourier moments, operator and nuclear budgets equal to input side N, ordinary original-vocabulary softmax CE at scale one. Each solver uses one fixed decoder. The four maps are d_w(z)=floor(min(z,q-z)/w), w=1,2,3,4; these vocabulary-only latent lookup tables are identical across task names and read no input arithmetic rule. This is an explicit structural prior, not unrestricted decoder learning or optimization over the full decoder hull.
discovery: Categorical training triples only. Order observed anchors by descending incident degree, then total bank anchor-fiber size, then lexicographic triple. Retain the complete independently checked whole-bank certificate with largest singleton coverage, ties first. Stop on full coverage, sound bank inconsistency or fixed caps. Every attempt, cost and refusal stays recorded. A later budget refusal may retain an earlier complete certificate; incomplete unions never constrain the model. Do not merge different anchors' equalities. Identification is conditional on the unknown target belonging to the declared bank family.
solver: For each of the four decoders in declaration order, retain explicit no-certificate/no-live-branch/out-of-image outcomes or train a uniform-initialized full-state solver with the selected whole-bank constraints. Full evaluates all CE gradients; mini uses persistent sample gradients and the original seeded shuffle, batch size and tails; forward uses zero derivatives and observed-label fiber projections. The same certificate is constructed and charged once per task/mode case, then shared among its four candidates. Keep all candidate work. Use the original observation cadence, capped by steps per epoch. Stop after a positive update at a scheduled observation if CE excess is <=1e-8, otherwise at the fixed update cap. Check all-frequency endpoint norms after at most twelve repair bisections. No convergence or interval certificate is claimed.
selection: Finish all four candidate endpoints before reading any held-out metric. Select the first candidate within 1e-8 of the common training CE lower bound, otherwise the smallest training CE. Then evaluate every completed candidate on every original split. A pass requires at least 99 percent exact sequences on the primary split and separately all held-out splits. Retain every refusal, process failure and nonselected candidate; a process failure or absent endpoint has no score.
replay: Rebuild unchanged data and verify every fingerprint. Repeat every anchor attempt, certificate choice, original minibatch schedule, update and endpoint. Compare complete saved state, coordinates, trace, counters and stopping. Independently recompute decoder sums, all nonconstant complex DFT matrices, SVD norms, ordinary CE and every split metric directly from saved latent coordinates. Shared frozen generators and LAPACK are explicit. Seals bind every artifact digest; altered or incomplete successful outcomes cannot enter the summary.
comparison: This adaptive nine-task extension preserves all earlier candidates and the original full35 short/long goal. Integrate by training CE only after complete audited predecessor evidence exists, including the full-suite baseline for the long blind case. The standalone cohort does not claim a full35 pass or a fresh transformer comparison.
resources: Freeze committed source, protocol, producer binary and source fingerprint before prepare or any original discovery. One numerical process and one BLAS thread in this cohort, each under the user's 64 GiB address-space limit with explicit buffer preflight. Require a 16 GiB disk reserve before each case. Never overwrite or resume a started cell. Record process exit status and retain partial files on failure, then continue remaining planned cases. Store generated evidence only in ignored root runs. Frozen earlier cohorts keep their original limits.
